monsterDescriptions.text: A huge yeti-like creature they travel in small packs and ambush their prey from hidden snow traps.
Living in norther areas or areas where there is permafrost.  They are of a nasty disposition and will always attack those they think are weaker than they.
Captain of the Winterhaven guard.  Ramius is as stalwart a fighter as Winterhaven has ever seen and a noble man.
Of moderate skill these men are the spies Morbius the evil litch has sent out in search of "The Geyser"
Harpies are considered among the most evil minded of creatures.  In termes of pure evil thoughts, they are second only to the shadow elves.
Be careful not to fall victim to the special powers of the Cockatrice.  Many strong warriors have had their fate sealed in stone.
A powerful troll, grack was poisoned when you found him.  Only his natural ability to regenerate keeps him from death.
A powerful ogre with an intense hatred for all trolls.  Bolo is on a life quest to rid the Realmz of all trolls and thier kin.
A strange creature indeed.  With little ability to move, they strike at thier prey with magical attacks.
Oleo was a powerful enchanter tricked by Morbius.  He secretly wishes to defeat Morbius if he only had the power.
A larger version of the ordinary troll.  The physical strength of these beasts is near god-like.
Capable of regenerating, these creatures are almost indestructible.
A small, but deadly variety of your every day troll.
Mounted on a large slug capable of spitting acid, these small but goodly people are constantly at war with thier neighbors the Snail Jockies.
Mounted upon a large snail capable of spitting acid, these small malichious folk are constaly at war with thier neighbors the Slug Knights.
Sickly in appearance this three legged and three armed monster is build like a cast iron stove.  Sharp weapons do it no harm as you need to litterly crack it open like a lobster.
Hailing from some remote area of the Abyss the Xonokite are shunned by even other demon kind for they love to torture those weaker than themselves.
Do not get too close!  If it gets you in a bear hug you are doomed for sure.
A throwback to the ancient past.  Thought to have been extinct, many of these powerful creatures still lurk in lost caverns below the surface of the Realmz.
Sporting a nasty bite, these critters are more dangerous than they appear.  Razor sharp spikes pepper the back of this cave dweller.
Used for hard labor under the worst of conditions.  They are ill tempered and wish to rebell against their tormenters.
Used for hard labor under the worst of conditions.  They are ill tempered and wish to rebell against their tormenters.
These giant reptiles can survive in almost any hostile environment.
Used to keep the working trolls in line and working hard.  They are brutal masters and must be careful around the workers to avoid being attacked.
Noolum befriended you when you set his people free from slavery at the hands of Morbius.
Belonging to the arachnid family, these large critters pack a paralyzing sting.
Ratius Giantous
A large sea going reptilian.  They dwell in large underground streams and eat most fish.  However, they will eat just about anything they can catch.
Only two feet tall, fire sprites are capable of overwhelming foes by sheer numbers.
Only two feet tall, fire sprites are capable of overwhelming foes by sheer numbers.
River Devils are not true devils.  They gain the name because they tend to attack near water of any sort.  They are lightning quick.
Strongest of the evil dragons.  Few  have met with one AND LIVED!
Capable of breathing lightning.  Woe to the fools that find themselves in lonely company with one such as this.
One of the weaker races of dragon kind.  A sly mind and a taste for blood make green dragons a force to be feared.
Hailing from the deepest reaches of the underworld.  These powerful wyrmss hate all life.
Hailing from the deepest reaches of the underworld.  These powerful wyrmss hate all life.
These creatures are often used to guard treasure for they are difficult to kill.  They have a remarkable power to regenerate wounds.
A close cousin to the red dragon.  These creatures are more common in the Abyss than on the material plane.
Strongest of the good dragons.  This race of dragon kind devotes their entire lives to the destruction of their evil kin.
It was said that these creatures did not exist.  Nobody could ever prove they did, for nobody who went looking ever came back.   Till one day a dwarven miner managed to capture one.
Standing 8 feet tall or more, these large brutes love to bully those weaker than themselves.  They are often employed as troops in mercenary armies.
Extremely strong for their size, these beasts would make excellent warriors if they were not so lazy.
A cursed humanoid who has the ability to change into a giant rat-like form.  After a few years, the rat-like form becomes the norm as they are twisted by the curse.
A cursed humanoid who has the ability to change into a giant dog-like form.  After a few years, the dog-like form becomes the norm as they are twisted by the curse.
Though they are more than capable of attacking with arms and weapons they often emply magic as well.
Golquin is a large frost giant employed by Morbius as captain of the guard for a portion of his fortress.
Captured by the Bloony Man and later set free by  your brave deeds.
Captured by the Bloony Man and later set free by  your brave deeds.
Short tenticals spiked with stingers.  The venom will paralyze on contact.
A giant six legged creature feared for its ability to turn its enemies to stone.
A disgusting creature at best.  This tri-leged, tri-tentacled beast feeds on the refuse of others.  They ingest huge amounts of garbage and carrion.
Looking more like a two legged tank than a crab, these creatures have a hard shell that will repel most weapons.  It takes a good smashing weapon to crack its armor.
Newtonians favor the dank and foul subteranian lakes and rivers.  They will climb to higher reaches on occasion to hunt for food and prisoners.
Found in only the darkest and coldest of underground streams, the river drake is a solitary but powerful beast.
Morbius is a powerful Demi Litch.  You have met him before and nearly lost your lives each time.
Morbius is a powerful Demi Litch.  You have met him before and nearly lost your lives each time.
With the Stick Pin embedded in his chest, morbius is unable to reform if he falls in combat.
The bulk of the Acid Claw Brigade consists of simple foot warriors such as this.
A more skilled warrior who has lived through a number of battles.  No easy mark to be sure.
A more skilled warrior who has lived through a more battles than he can rembember.
Leader of a company of men.  Skilled in both weapons and diplomacy.
In charge of the 12th Acid Claw Brigade, Gail was tasked with aiding Morbius in finding 'The Geyser'
Formed from a colony of semi-intelligent mosses.  Shrills can inflict a withering disease on those it can infect.  They are immune to all forms of magic.
A massive beast of a size you have never seen.  It dwarfs any other land creature you have ever seen to include dragons.
A massive snake-like creature with a poisonous bite.
Capable of inflicting a strong chemical burn.
Capable of inflicting a strong chemical burn.
Massive in size, these Wooly Beasts have been blinded.  They hunt by sound alone.
A race of cave dwelling reptiles, they band together in large number to ambush the weak.
In life, a formerly valiant warrior. In death, it is now a cursed pawn of whoever may contol it.
These young will aid you in battle.  However, they tend to panic and run if hurt badly.
Huge and immensly strong, rock giants tend to hurl large stones in battle.
When an evil giant wizard passes beyound, they often attempt to become a litch.  If they only partialy success, this is their horrific fate.
A real monster.  Fortunately, this eight-legged monstrosity has NO venom.
Be careful not to fall victim to a bite from one of these.  Their bite has been known to cause paralysis.
Malicus is a large snow giant battle mage who rules the southern regions of the Silver Peak mountains.
Volmax was a coward who was cursed to relive the death of his men.  Morbius later tricked him and made his curse all the worse by forcing him to live in silence among his dead men.
Volmax is a true Litch just like Morbius and thus a threat to Morbius.  Morbius had him imprisoned until you freed him by mistake.
Ill tempered at best, Snow Giants often keep vusk as pets.
Ill tempered at best, Snow Giants often keep vusk as pets.
Ill tempered at best, Snow Giants often keep vusk as pets.
Conjured from the "Orb of Chaos" these phantoms will fight at your side.
Made from buring flames and embers, these magical guardians will fight to the death.
Galarn is a cowardly ruler and will flee in battle when wounded.
More legend and old wives tale than fact, the Bloony Man is used in stories to scare young dwarven children.
A brave but somewhat unskilled troop.
A conscript with little to look forward to in the civilian world.  For this reason they often reenlist to become corporals.
Charged to keep the troops in line.
A true leader of men.
Skilled in the ways of combat and leadership.  An up and coming officer.
A skilled warrior of the dwarven nations.
A skilled warrior of the dwarven nations.
Golian Giants are very tough but also very stupid.  So stupid in fact that they are often found working as mercinaries for anybody who will cloth and feed them.
Brim is a massive Golian Giant.  However, he does require a certain amount of verbal abuse to get him to act on your behalf and is prone to run away when hurt.
A cross between a demon and a vampire this creature has the strengths of both and the weakness of neither.
Made from the very earth itself, these magical creatures are often summoned to aid a priest in battle.
A shadow drake of such power as to be almost godlike.  Marcus Vilewing is immune to nearly all magic.
Native to underground rivers and streams they attack in large packs.
Having been born an obsenity to nature, this Mutant will destroy all in its path.
You befriended this Avian when you helped it against a battle with Harpies and Griffons.
An underground dweller that is more reptile than man.  They hate all surface dwellers.
A mountainous man-fish.
A sturdy warrior of the dwarven clans.
A sturdy warrior of the dwarven clans.
A sturdy warrior of the dwarven clans.
A sturdy warrior of the dwarven clans.
King of the dwarven clans that reside under Silver Peak Mountains.
One of six warriors selected to join your party in quest to recapture 'The Geyser'
A common orc who claims to have some skill with weapons.
A warrior of great skill and strength.
Strong and capable with arms.
Skilled in the use of a bow.  These warriors prefer to pepper their enemies with fine yew wood shafts.
Skilled in the arts of magic, Shadow Elven mages are to be feared.  They will use their fowl magic to charm enemies if given the chance.
Poisoned weapons are but one of the cheap and dirty tricks used by these black souled rogues.
Quicker than a cobra strike these ill tempered brutes live for battle.  Few can best them in the art of sword play.
Capable fighters but they prefer to stand back and lob missile of death upon their foes.
Second to none in the ability to show cruelty to others.  None will challange their rule for fear of banishment.
Exiled from her people for showing signs of compassion towards other not of her race.
A huge beast that hunts by mimicing the floor of old desolate castles.  There are other creatures similar in nature but this particular one is huge!
Yemire has died but does not realise he is now but a ghost.
A true freak of nature.  The creature has a body made of mostly metals.  The only way to damage such a beast it to litteraly pound it to dust.
Grog is from a place beyond the stars.  He seeks to regain "The Geyser" as it was stolen from him by the Acid Claw Brigade.
Completely mindless.  Whelps live in underground lakes and pools.
A true freak of nature.  The creature has a body made of mostly metals.  The only way to damage such a beast it to litteraly pound it to dust.
A massive creature indeed.  Muscle bound arms and legs propell this monstrosity.  A large insectoid head sports several sets of eyes.  Beware the stare!
A bizzare beast with tenticles were a mouth should be.  This creature enjoys extracting the brain matter from its prey while it is still squirming in its grasp.  Ish!
With a physical strenght to rival the gods, these beasts of the caves are feared by all.
A thick shell makes this creature all but indestructible by bladed weapons.  It has two legs and a third appendage that has a huge claw.  It also has large pinchers for a mouth.
The Alien Mantis can thrive on meat, plants or just about anything else it can stuff into its powerful mandibles.  It's lightning fast and twice as deadly.
Commonly known as IRON WINGS, as they favor the wearing of alloy battle masks.
Commonly known as SATIN WINGS, as they have a soft velvety hair that covers their wings.
Many a wary creature has fallen prey to this ingeneous carnivore.  It will lay in wait for days for an unwary traveler.  They frequent castles and dungeons.
Arch enemy of Grog, Renvild has sworn to destroy grogg and to enslave his followers.  Renvild favors a magical staff he aquired while in the Realmz.  He also practices magic as well.
A true freak of nature.  The creature has a body made of mostly metals.  The only way to damage such a beast it to litteraly pound it to dust.
An evil race of ogres that have great malice for any surface dwelling race.
Ions ago a race of trolls became infected with a terrible disease.  Though they have since become immune to disease, the descendents have suffered perminent damage.

Completely mindless.  Whelps live in underground lakes and pools.  The Dark Whelp is a rare mutated form of the normal Whelp.
Small and fast your typical Defense Drone is used for scouting as well as close support defense.
Small and fast your typical Combat Drone is used for scouting as well as fast hit and run operations.
Blazing fast speed but lightly armed and armored.  The Probe is used for target spotting and comand and control operations.
Heavily armed and armored the Attack Droid is often the first line of offense and defense.
Built by the Galactic Centurions. Imense in size Assault Bots are expensive to construct.  They are the most deadly fighting machines ever constructed.

Built by the Galactic Centurions. Combots are large, measuring 15 feet in height.  They are quick and armed with a dule set of Split Beam Violators giving them an immense amount of offensive firepower.
Built by the Galactic Centurions.  At 12 feet in height Battle Droids are the smallest of the walking war machines.  They still pack an incredible punch.
Golians are an evil race from a world beyond the stars.  Their ship crashed in the Realmz and they have been working to repair and escape for decades.

Loners in the world of the Abyss.  They are among the rarest of demons.  It is rumored that only a few clans of these demons still survive.
A massive goblin who rules clan Hollowtooth.  He is always guarded by a trio of pitted warriors.
Flibli is a respected cleric of the Gnomish people.  He was sent on a mission to open relations with Winterhaven.
A powerful spirit that only wishes peace.  It will destroy anything that treatons its tranquility.
Prefering to roam in large bands, they raid town and villages in the underworld.  They are like locusts, living on the spoils of one sacked village after another.
